svg.title: World map (Pacific centered)
svg.desc: Made with Natural Earth (public domain). Equirectangular, lon -11..349 (Pacific centered), lat 83.6..-56.0. Same path data as _unused/world-map.svg drawn twice and shifted by 469.4444px, so the seam sits at 11W - just west of Greenland's eastern tip, which keeps Greenland whole at the right edge. The right copy is drawn in two nested viewports: full width above y=80 (about 55N, where Greenland and Iceland live) and only up to x=950 below it. That drops the strip of NW African coast west of 11W plus the mid-Atlantic islands, which would otherwise float alone at the right edge with no land around them. (Nested svg is used instead of clip-path because clip-path on use was not applied in testing.)
